top_signals.title: The cartel civil war tearing apart a Mexican state
top_signals.summary: The Sinaloa cartel erupted into conflict in 2024 when the son of Joaquín ‘El Chapo’ Guzmán kidnapped his father’s co-founder and handed him to US authorities
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Glencore Allowed to Pursue $230 Million  Case Against UK’s Prax
top_signals.summary: One of the world’s largest commodity traders has been granted permission to sue Prax Lindsey Oil Refinery Ltd over more than $230 million of oil it says was never paid for.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.summary: Britain risks becoming “dangerously dependent” on a handful of foreign tech companies as AI spreads through businesses and public services, the founder of GOV.UK has warned.
